title: The claim, version 1
description: The body of POST /v1/claim, as a claimant sends it (relay-claim/v1.md, Messages and fields). A relay refuses a member it does not know.

collector_url.description: http://collector.tunnel selects the tunnel; any other value is the collector's base URL, which the relay requests itself (CLAIM-21 to CLAIM-23).

collector_token.description: The bearer token of the build's session at the collector; empty sends none (CLAIM-24).

capture_mode.description: What the relay captures of the build's proxied exchanges (CLAIM-25).

upstream_ca_certs.description: Extra roots for the relay's upstream TLS, each a PEM bundle of one or more certificates (CLAIM-26).

upstream_system_ca.description: false, with a non-empty upstream_ca_certs, leaves the system roots out (CLAIM-27).

environment.description: The build's base environment, recorded as the ledger's environment record (CLAIM-28).

type.description: The type the payload names, when given.

payload.description: A JSON object that names its own type, at most 1 MiB once decoded, in standard base64 with padding.

metadata.description: A CBOR map whose keys are text strings, in standard base64 with padding.

build_link.description: The private segment between the relay and the build environment, IPv4 (CLAIM-29).

prefix.description: The segment's network address with its length, 8 to 30.

relay.description: The relay's address on the segment.

guest.description: The build environment's address on the segment.

upstream_dns.description: The relay's resolvers, IPv4 addresses with port 53 implied, in the order it asks them (CLAIM-30, CLAIM-31).
